## Checklist
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No customer or internal-product names, no secrets
- [ ] A fixed defect has a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] A new gate was proven red first (a planted defect turns it red)
- [ ] Sentinel change classified: Compatible / Behavioural / Breaking (changelog updated)
